title: Evolution strategies as a scalable alternative to reinforcement learning
summary: We’ve discovered that evolution strategies (ES), an optimization technique that’s been known for decades, rivals the performance of standard reinforcement learning (RL) techniques on modern RL benchmarks (e.g. Atari/MuJoCo), while overcoming many of RL’s inconveniences.
body: We’ve discovered that evolution strategies (ES), an optimization technique that’s been known for decades, rivals the performance of standard reinforcement learning (RL) techniques on modern RL benchmarks (e.g. Atari/MuJoCo), while overcoming many of RL’s inconveniences.
summaryZh: OpenAI的研究表明，进化策略（Evolution Strategies）作为一种经典的优化技术，在Atari和MuJoCo等现代强化学习基准测试中，能够达到与标准强化学习方法相当的性能。该研究不仅验证了进化策略的可扩展性，还通过简化训练流程克服了传统强化学习在实际应用中的诸多不便，为复杂任务的策略优化提供了新的技术路径与理论参考。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究提出进化策略作为强化学习的替代方案，并在主流基准测试中表现出竞争力。
